comment: Daryl is an awful teacher. She is a touch grader. She is not able to inspire of make connections with students and complains about class discussion being poor when she doesn't come prepared to lead a discussion. Would never take her again.

Very fair. Places lots of emphasis on class attendance and discussion. Leads discussion very well. Essays aren't graded too hard (but still are graded hard to an extent), but midterms and finals require a lot of writing (I think that is the case for every core class though).

Very compassionate and helpful! EXTREMELY knowledgeable about her discipline and will bend over backward and work with you! Her grading is strict, remember, she is an author of four or five books, so keep in mind that when you are doing your presentations, she already KNOWS what you SHOULD be talking about and will ask questions on the topics you d

I took this class the first year Dance was at UR (1993?)  She was terrific.  I think I got a B in the class, but learned a lot. She arranged Nikki Giovvanni and Paule Marshall as guest lectures.  Super!

Not a class for slackers... If you want to work, Dr. Dance will reward your work with personal guidance & fair grading.  If you're trying to slack, don't take the class.  Reading was reasonable and most interesting material I've encountered in college.  She expects a lot from her students but is inspirational in return.  Best Eng. course I've had.

I thought Dance and her class were great. The reading assignments are sometimes very long, but fairly interesting. All you have to do is actually do the readings and everything else will fall into place...Im not an exeptional writer but got an A-
This class is awful, theres no structure. The interesting material becomes a chore to get through. Dance is very self-centered and it shows in the way she grades.
Easy A for a lot of people but I know some students had problems- just do the work and it's a piece of cake.
I took a course with her her first year 92-interesting.She brought in guest speakers Paula Marshall-I never found any Richmond teachers very helpful,except ED dept. which they eliminated.
She is a good professor, but you need to work for your grade
